Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) grew annual revenue 2.1x in 4 years. What do the numbers say about that growth, and what don’t they say?

Latest fiscal year: FY2025 (ended Dec 27, 2025)
• Revenue: $34.6B (+34.3% YoY)
• Operating margin: 10.7%
• Net margin: 12.5%
• Free cash flow: $6.7B (19.4% of revenue)

Latest quarter (ended Sep 26, 2026, 10-Q)
• Revenue: $13.4B (+44.7% vs the same quarter a year earlier)
• Operating margin: 21.2%

4-year view (FY2021 → FY2025)
• Revenue: $16.4B → $34.6B (2.1x; compound annual growth 20.5%)
• Operating margin: 22.2% → 10.7% (−11.5 pts)
• Free cash flow: $3.2B → $6.7B
• Cash conversion: operating cash flow was 177.8% of net income
• Year that stands out: FY2023, operating margin 1.8%, revenue growth −3.9%
